summary:
Reviewed w110 commits 5d88909, aecf1e7, 2e956ab (they match the implementer's result).
The deprecated @r47 outline was retired as the work-item's Retires says; the gives_totals and stamp changes are covered by the plan. No other test was removed or weakened.
tools check: ruff, vulture clean; no import contracts. tools size: nothing over 300 lines.
Important, fix now: the empty-session.json mark is keyed by (work-item, stage name), so every run of a repeated stage gets it. On i22, w97's 6-review stage has 27 turns and its cost but is also marked session_json: empty, because 5-review's session.json is empty.
Minor, drop: the step change landed in stamp instead of transitions_between; the effect is the same.
questions: Important, scripts/measure_read.py:74 with scripts/measure_build.py:43: an empty session.json is keyed by (work-item, stage name), so another run of the same stage that has figures is also named as a stage whose session.json is empty (i22 w97 review, against r57).
